comment: The UPS Access License Number used to authenticate rate and label requests to UPS.
modal: The UPS-issued Access License Number that authorises this store's calls to the UPS API. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website, so separate UPS accounts can serve different websites.

comment: Enables UPS as a shipping method offered at checkout.
modal: When set to **Yes**, UPS rates are offered to customers at checkout. Set to **No** to hide UPS. Can be enabled per website.

comment: The UPS service levels offered to customers at checkout.
modal: Selects which UPS shipping services (service levels) are presented to customers. Only the methods chosen here are quoted. Can differ per website.

comment: How package weights are packaged into UPS rate requests.
modal: Chooses how the cart's weight is sent to UPS when requesting rates — as a single combined request or split across packages. Affects how multi-item orders are quoted. Can differ per website.

comment: The UPS packaging type used when requesting rates.
modal: The UPS container/packaging type assumed when quoting rates. Pick the packaging that matches how you ship. Can differ per website.

comment: Enables a free-shipping threshold for UPS based on order subtotal.
modal: When enabled, orders at or above the configured subtotal qualify for free UPS shipping. Can differ per website.

comment: The order subtotal at which UPS shipping becomes free.
modal: The minimum order subtotal that qualifies for free UPS shipping. Applies only when **Enable Free Shipping Threshold** is enabled. Can differ per website.

comment: The destination type UPS uses when calculating rates.
modal: Selects the kind of delivery destination UPS assumes when quoting rates, which can change the returned prices. Can differ per website.

comment: The UPS service level used for the free shipping option.
modal: The UPS service applied when an order qualifies for free shipping. Can differ per website.

comment: The UPS gateway URL used for rate requests.
modal: The endpoint URL this store calls to request UPS rates. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

comment: The URL of the UPS XML rate API endpoint.
modal: The endpoint URL used when UPS requests go through the legacy XML API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

comment: The URL of the UPS REST API endpoint.
modal: The endpoint URL used when UPS requests go through the REST API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether the handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage.
modal: Chooses whether the UPS handling fee is applied as a fixed amount or as a percentage of the shipping rate. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether the handling fee is applied per order or per package.
modal: Chooses whether the UPS handling fee is charged once per order or for each package. Can differ per website.

comment: The handling fee added to UPS shipping rates.
modal: The handling amount added to quoted UPS rates, interpreted as a fixed value or percentage per the **Calculate Handling Fee** setting. Can differ per website.

comment: The maximum package weight UPS will quote.
modal: The heaviest single package UPS will rate; consult UPS for the supported maximum. Orders above this may be split or return no rate. Can differ per website.

comment: The minimum package weight UPS will quote.
modal: The lightest single package UPS will rate; consult UPS for the supported minimum. Can differ per website.

comment: The UPS origin region that determines which shipping methods are available.
modal: The region the shipment originates from, which governs the set of UPS services that can be offered. Can differ per website.

comment: The password for the UPS account used to authenticate API requests.
modal: The password paired with the UPS user ID to authenticate API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: How packages are handed to UPS, which affects the rates returned.
modal: The pickup method describing how packages reach UPS (for example scheduled pickup or drop-off). The choice can change the rates UPS quotes. Can differ per website.

comment: The position of UPS relative to other shipping methods at checkout.
modal: Controls where UPS appears in the list of shipping methods; lower numbers sort higher. Can differ per website.

comment: The carrier name shown to customers at checkout for UPS.
modal: The heading customers see above the UPS shipping options at checkout. Can be set per store view, so each store can show a localised name.

comment: The URL of the UPS tracking XML endpoint.
modal: The endpoint URL used to retrieve UPS tracking information via the XML API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

comment: The URL of the UPS tracking REST endpoint.
modal: The endpoint URL used to retrieve UPS tracking information via the REST API. Change only if directed by UPS. Can differ per website.

comment: The UPS integration/account type used for rate requests.
modal: Selects which UPS integration this store uses when authenticating and requesting rates. Match it to the account type UPS provisioned. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether the UPS account runs against the live production API rather than a test environment.
modal: When **Yes**, requests go to the live UPS production environment; **No** targets the test environment. Can differ per website.

comment: The weight unit used in UPS rate requests.
modal: The unit of weight sent to UPS when quoting rates. Set it to match how product weights are recorded in your catalog. Can differ per website.

comment: The UPS user ID used to authenticate API requests.
modal: The UPS account user ID, paired with the password, used to authenticate API calls. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether to request UPS negotiated (account-specific) rates instead of published rates.
modal: When **Yes**, UPS returns the negotiated rates tied to your account rather than standard published rates. Requires a UPS account that is enabled for negotiated rates. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether UPS is offered to all countries or only to selected ones.
modal: Chooses between offering UPS to all allowed countries or restricting it to the countries chosen in **Ship to Specific Countries**. Can differ per website.

comment: The countries UPS can ship to when limited to specific countries.
modal: The set of destination countries for which UPS is offered. Applies when **Ship to Applicable Countries** is set to specific countries. Can differ per website.

comment: Whether to still show UPS at checkout when it returns no applicable rates.
modal: When **Yes**, UPS remains visible at checkout even when no rate is available, showing the configured error message instead of hiding the method. Can differ per website.

comment: The message shown to customers when UPS returns no available rates.
modal: The text displayed at checkout when UPS cannot provide a rate. Can be set per store view for localised messaging.

comment: Whether to log UPS request and response data for troubleshooting.
modal: When **Yes**, UPS API requests and responses are written to the debug log to help diagnose rating issues. Can differ per website.
